title: Brake Job Pricing Rules for Brake Service Warranties Lines
content:
**Pricing rule.** A brake job sold under Brake Service Warranties is priced per axle, for a vehicle whose class is among the eligible vehicle classes of the line.

- **Package lines.** Where rotors are part of the job price on the line, the job is sold at the line's package price per axle, which includes new rotors, pads, hardware and labor.
- **Itemized lines.** Otherwise the job price is the total of
  - the line's pad set price per axle;
  - the line's pad replacement labor price per axle;
  - the line's hardware kit price, only when the hardware kit is not included on the line;
  - for each of the axle's two rotors, either the line's price to resurface one rotor or its price for one new rotor installed, as the inspection requires under the line's rotor discard rule; and
  - the line's brake fluid exchange price, when the brake fluid test fails and the customer accepts the exchange.
- **Shop supplies fee.** A shop supplies fee of the line's shop supplies percentage of labor, capped at the line's highest shop supplies fee, is added to every paid repair order.
- **Personal use.** The lifetime lines are sold only for a vehicle in personal use.

**Tender.** A brake job paid with the Crestline Credit Card posts to the card account as a purchase on the job's date at the servicing store; a brake job charged to a Crestline Fleet Account posts as a fleet invoice for that vehicle, in the brakes service category, on the job's date at the servicing store.

**When each itemized component enters the price.**

| Component | Enters when |
|---|---|
| pad set, per axle | always |
| pad replacement labor, per axle | always |
| hardware kit | the line does not include the kit |
| rotor work, for each of the two rotors | the inspection requires resurfacing or a new rotor for that rotor |
| brake fluid exchange | the fluid test fails and the customer accepts the exchange |

**Worked illustrations.** All figures below are illustrative inputs chosen for the arithmetic, not the prices of any Crestline line: pad set 100.00, labor 120.00, hardware kit not included at 10.00, resurfacing 20.00 per rotor, new rotor 60.00 per rotor, fluid exchange 80.00, shop supplies 10 percent of labor capped at 20.00.

1. *Both rotors resurfaced, fluid test passed.* The job price is the total of 100.00, 120.00, 10.00, and 20.00 for each of the two rotors: 270.00. The shop supplies fee is 10 percent of the 120.00 labor, 12.00, below the 20.00 cap. The repair order totals 282.00.
2. *One rotor below the maker's minimum thickness, fluid test failed and the exchange accepted.* The rotor below minimum takes a new rotor at 60.00 and the other is resurfaced at 20.00; the fluid exchange adds 80.00. The job price is the total of 100.00, 120.00, 10.00, 60.00, 20.00 and 80.00: 390.00. With the 12.00 shop supplies fee the repair order totals 402.00.
3. *Package line.* With an illustrative package price of 400.00 per axle, the job is sold at 400.00 for the axle, the package including new rotors, pads, hardware and labor.
